title: Transformation of 3-(4-methoxybenzylidine)-5-(p-tolyl)-2(3H)-furanone into new nitrogen heterocyclic candidates as insecticidal agents with in silico studies

A series of pyrrolones was synthesized and biologically evaluated, revealing strong to moderate larvicidal activity against Culex pipiens, with exceptional potency of compound 4, supported by computational studies.
